python3 -c '
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img43 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0043.png"))

# Camera pose: (0.7071, 4.7071), heading 180 deg (-y)
# Plant 2 pot base in obs 43:
# Bottom of pot
mask_pot = (img43[:,:,0] > 140) & (img43[:,:,1] > 60) & (img43[:,:,1] < 120) & (img43[:,:,2] < 70) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 400)
coords_pot = np.argwhere(mask_pot)
print("Plant 2 pot base y range:", coords_pot[:,0].min(), coords_pot[:,0].max(), "x range:", coords_pot[:,1].min(), coords_pot[:,1].max())

# In heading 180 deg:
# Forward is -y, Right is -x.
# Camera pose: (0.7071, 4.7071)
y_contact = coords_pot[:,0].max() + 0.5
x_contact = (coords_pot[:,1].min() + coords_pot[:,1].max()) / 2.0
d = 396.8 / (y_contact - 255.5)
xc = (x_contact - 255.5) / 256.0 * d

world_x = 0.7071 - xc
world_y = 4.7071 - d
print(f"Plant 2 from obs 43: d={d:.3f}, x={world_x:.3f}, y={world_y:.3f}")
'
